plan.notes: Source: SUNY Delhi official Acalog 'Business Administration - AS' (SUNY Curriculum Code 0671, HEGIS 5004.00), catalog.delhi.edu. Four semesters transcribed exactly as published: 16+15+12+18 = 61, matching the published 'Minimum Total Credit Hours = 61' (variable-credit slots resolved at their minimum: Third Semester 23MA choice transcribed as MATH 150 at 3 credits; published alternatives MATH 210 / MATH 128 add a 4th credit for 61-63 total). Prerequisite ordering verified: ACCT 115 Financial Accounting (Sem 1) before ACCT 125 Managerial Accounting (Sem 2). Published rules documented: Restricted electives = any 100-/200-level ACCT, BUSI, or CITA course (management course recommended: BUSI 200 Management I, BUSI 205 Small Business Management, or BUSI 263 Entrepreneurship); General Education Elective 2 choices (23UC US History & Civic Engagement, 23AR The Arts, 23WG World History & Global Awareness, 23HU Humanities, 23WL World Languages) must span at least three different SUNY knowledge areas. Degree classification: AS = transfer-oriented (SUNY transfer AS). Catalog year honest note: 2024-2025 is the newest Acalog edition with indexed program pages (a 2025-2026 catalog homepage exists but its program pages were not retrievable at collection time); re-verify against the 2025-2026 edition when available.
